core.title: Hi, I'm Laura.
core.role: Full-stack developer: data, maps and, more and more, AI.

I care as much about the interface as about what's behind it, and now I'm adding AI to the mix with local vision models, RAG systems and coding agents in my daily work.

caseStudy.title: Case study: receipts and invoices read by a local AI
caseStudy.lede: Give it a photo of a document and it returns the data ready to use, with a vision model that runs locally.

blocks.title: What it does
blocks.body: It takes a photo of a document, decides whether it is a receipt, an invoice or neither, and extracts the category, amount, currency and other key fields. If the image is invalid or unreadable, it returns a clear error.

blocks.title: How it works
blocks.body: A FastAPI API sends the image to a vision model running locally on Ollama and turns its answer into structured JSON, ready to plug into any system.

blocks.title: Why local
blocks.body: Privacy by design: the model runs on the organisation's own infrastructure and no document is ever sent to external services.

blocks.title: My role
blocks.body: I built it together with a colleague: from the API to the model integration and the response format.

caseStudy.note: Internal project: no confidential code or data is shown.

horizon.title: Education & the road to AI
horizon.intro: I started with the fundamentals — how neural networks, transformers and embeddings work under the hood — and now I bring AI into real projects, at work and at home.

road.text: Building an educational chatbot with a custom LlamaIndex RAG.
Working with local AI (Ollama) and coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex.
Taking RAG assistants and AI-powered apps to production for clients and teams.

horizon.closing: My edge: I can build everything around the model — the interface, the API, the data and the deployment.
